localizedText.zh-CN: 提取CSS与设计令牌文档
localizedText.en: Extract CSS and design-token documentation

localizedText.zh-CN: 显式配置或直接输入构造运行请求，提取CSS、PostCSS与设计令牌文档。
localizedText.en: Build a request from explicit configuration or direct inputs to extract CSS, PostCSS and design-token documentation.

localizedText.zh-CN: cssdoc --config cssdoc.config.json
localizedText.en: cssdoc --config cssdoc.config.json

localizedText.zh-CN: 配置模式中，CLI可覆盖out-dir、sources-content-policy及no-doc-source-map。
localizedText.en: In config mode CLI can override out-dir, sources-content-policy and no-doc-source-map.

localizedText.zh-CN: kind及workspace-root用于直接模式；配置模式忽略它们和位置输入。
localizedText.en: kind and workspace-root apply to direct mode; config mode ignores them and positional inputs.

localizedText.zh-CN: 配置文件相对调用目录，配置工作区相对配置目录；输出相对所选工作区。
localizedText.en: Config paths use cwd, configured workspaces use the config directory, and output uses the selected workspace.

localizedText.zh-CN: 运行会创建目录并写工件，失败时可能已写部分文件。embed策略会写入获准公开的源码正文。
localizedText.en: Runs create directories and artifacts; failures may leave partial output. The embed policy includes source bodies authorized for publication.

localizedText.zh-CN: Node严格解析先于帮助；未知、缺值或类型错误返回1。重复带值选项取最后值，--之后作为位置输入。
localizedText.en: Node strict parsing precedes help; unknown, missing or invalid option values exit 1. Repeated value options use the last value, and tokens after -- are positional inputs.
